```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(terra)
library(fs)
library(stringr)

main_dir <- "/projectnb/dietzelab/dongchen/anchorSites/NA_runs/SDA_8k_site/downscale_maps_analysis_lc_ts_noGEDI/"
nlcd_path <- "/projectnb/dietzelab/dongchen/anchorSites/downscale/MODIS_NLCD_LC.tif"

years <- 2012:2024
ensembles <- 1:25

decid.SLA <- 1/15.17639
con.SLA   <- 1/4.190841

# helpers
make_masks <- function(nlcd) {
  list(
    All = ifel(nlcd %in% c(41, 42), 1, NA),
    Con = ifel(nlcd == 42, 1, NA),
    Dec = ifel(nlcd == 41, 1, NA)
  )
}

make_SLA <- function(nlcd) {
  classify(nlcd,
           matrix(c(42, con.SLA,
                    41, decid.SLA), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE),
           others = NA)
}

# Return the ensemble files (format /LAI_2012)
ens_files <- function(var, year) {
  folder <- file.path(main_dir, paste0(var, "_", year))
  dir_ls(folder, regexp = "\\.tiff?$", type = "file")
}

# Update running sum + count
accum_update <- function(sum_r, n_r, x) {
  ok <- !is.na(x)
  sum_r <- sum_r + ifel(ok, x, 0)
  n_r   <- n_r   + ifel(ok, 1, 0)
  list(sum = sum_r, n = n_r)
}

nlcd <- rast(nlcd_path)
masks <- make_masks(nlcd)
SLA   <- make_SLA(nlcd)

# store final accumulators per mask and variable
init_acc <- function(template) list(sum = template*0, n = template*0)

all_years <- list()
for (nm in names(masks)) {
  all_years[[nm]] <- list(
    FC = init_acc(masks[[nm]]),
    WC = init_acc(masks[[nm]]),
    TC = init_acc(masks[[nm]])
  )
}

for (yr in years) {
  lai_files  <- ens_files("LAI", yr)
  wood_files <- ens_files("AbvGrndWood", yr)

  # you need the files to align by ensemble; simplest is sort and assume same ordering
  lai_files  <- sort(lai_files)
  wood_files <- sort(wood_files)

  # per-year accumulators (reset each year)
  per_year <- list()
  for (nm in names(masks)) {
    per_year[[nm]] <- list(
      FC = init_acc(masks[[nm]]),
      WC = init_acc(masks[[nm]])
    )
  }

  for (i in seq_along(ensembles)) {
    lai  <- rast(lai_files[i])
    wood <- rast(wood_files[i])

    for (nm in names(masks)) {
      mk <- masks[[nm]]

      # mask + transform 
      lai_m  <- mask(lai, mk)
      wood_m <- mask(wood, mk)

      FC <- lai_m * SLA * 0.5 
      WC <- wood_m * 0.1          

      per_year[[nm]]$FC <- accum_update(per_year[[nm]]$FC$sum, per_year[[nm]]$FC$n, FC)
      per_year[[nm]]$WC <- accum_update(per_year[[nm]]$WC$sum, per_year[[nm]]$WC$n, WC)

      rm(lai_m, wood_m, FC, WC); gc()
    }

    rm(lai, wood); gc()
  }

  # finalize yearly means, update all-years accumulators
  for (nm in names(masks)) {
    FC_mean <- per_year[[nm]]$FC$sum / per_year[[nm]]$FC$n
    WC_mean <- per_year[[nm]]$WC$sum / per_year[[nm]]$WC$n
    TC_mean <- FC_mean + WC_mean

    all_years[[nm]]$FC <- accum_update(all_years[[nm]]$FC$sum, all_years[[nm]]$FC$n, FC_mean)
    all_years[[nm]]$WC <- accum_update(all_years[[nm]]$WC$sum, all_years[[nm]]$WC$n, WC_mean)
    all_years[[nm]]$TC <- accum_update(all_years[[nm]]$TC$sum, all_years[[nm]]$TC$n, TC_mean)

    rm(FC_mean, WC_mean, TC_mean); gc()
  }

  message("done year ", yr)
}

# final all-years mean rasters in memory 
final_mean <- list()
for (nm in names(masks)) {
  final_mean[[nm]] <- list(
    FC = all_years[[nm]]$FC$sum / all_years[[nm]]$FC$n,
    WC = all_years[[nm]]$WC$sum / all_years[[nm]]$WC$n,
    TC = all_years[[nm]]$TC$sum / all_years[[nm]]$TC$n
  )
}

# Rrite final means (3 rasters × 3 masks = 9 outputs) 
writeRaster(final_mean$All$TC, "TC_mean_all_years.tif", overwrite=TRUE)

```
